newsitem.title: FINLAND: Paribas tips Orion for growth - paper.
newsitem.headline: Paribas tips Orion for growth - paper.

text.p: French investment bank Paribas sees Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy as a growth company next year and has a 'buy' recommendation on the share, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Friday.
The investment bank expects Orion's net profit to rise to 554 million markka next year and to 652 million in 1998, the paper said. Orion's 1995 net profit was 544.2 million markka.

Paribas predicted that sales of Orion's breast cancer drug Fareston and its Comtan Parkinson's disease drug -- both new developments -- could rise to 350 million dollars (1.6 billion markka) by the year 2003.
Orion's profits could rise to 860 million markka by the year 2000, with net sales rising to 5.5 billion markka and earnings per share to 17.2 markka, the paper said.
Paribas had a 'buy' recommendation on the share and said the share price could rise by about 28 percent, the paper said.

Orion which trades at about 15 times earnings was clearly undervalued in comparison with leading pharmaceuticals companies which have corresponding ratios of over 20, Kauppalehti quoted the bank as saying.
